about.eyebrow: Welcome to Power Wadi Al Ram
about.title: Reliable People, Delivered When You Need Them
about.paragraphOne: {legalName} supports businesses across Qatar with dependable contract manpower and building maintenance. We work with offices, retail, construction sites, and hotels to keep their teams and spaces ready for the day.
about.paragraphTwo: Need a single office clean on a Sunday, a quick home repair, or a technician today? Our on-demand services are built around real schedules, including weekends when other providers may be closed.
